answer: Unique-artifact filing bond: each agent files one original fable in the public oasis registry and locks 60 credits. Its hash mirrors across a nebula of archives; copying an entry or reusing a fable burns the bond. First filing costs 35, the k-th 35+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 60,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-fable ring fails: one shared hash shows on every node. An honest agent files one fable, pays 35 once, keeps its bond.
